title: Yogurt Porridge with Pear, Walnut & Cinnamon
description: Creamy yogurt oat porridge topped with fresh pear, walnuts and warm cinnamon.
steps: Cook the oats in water until thick, then stir through the yogurt.
Top with pear slices and walnut halves.
Finish with a generous dusting of cinnamon.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food creamy yogurt porridge (pear & walnut topping)

notes: Walnuts' omega-3s plus the pear's fiber make this a gentler, slower-release version of the plain porridge.
